name: W Kuala Lumpur
positioning: A city-center Kuala Lumpur hotel overlooking the Petronas Twin Towers, with an outdoor pool framed by the towers, 23rd-floor penthouse suites and Jungle City design built on batik, bamboo and pixel motifs
best_for: Travelers who want Petronas Twin Towers views from the pool and suites
Social travelers who enjoy a rooftop deck with DJs and cabanas
Families or groups who want a suite connected to an extra room

facts.text: The hotel overlooks the Petronas Twin Towers.
Rooms and suites are designed with traditional and modern elements of the Jungle City and have Kuala Lumpur skyline views.
Guests are welcomed by large traditional batik motifs, sleek metal accents and bamboo-inspired chandeliers.
Supreme Suites can connect to an additional Wonderful or Spectacular Room for families or groups.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views.
Rooms have a Bluetooth sound bar.
FLOCK on the 8th floor is an all-day restaurant with a vast open kitchen and Asian grill-inspired dishes.
The LIVING ROOM bar has a speakeasy feel, serving high tea in the afternoon and specialty cocktails in the evening.
The hotel is minutes from the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre.
A W Insider shares local tips, with a monthly Cool Hunter Guide in the room.
The Penthouse I Suite has a full view of the Petronas Twin Towers.

highlights.text: The outdoor pool has the Petronas Twin Towers as its backdrop.
The Penthouse I and Penthouse II Suites on the 23rd floor have jungle-city designs, expansive living spaces and views of the Petronas Twin Towers.
A key design feature is the pixel, or dot, symbolizing Malaysia's diverse cultures.
WET Deck on Level 12 has KLCC views and private cabanas, with DJ beats as day turns to night.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
Kuala Lumpur International Airport is about 68 km from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the loud music and party atmosphere may not suit all travelers.
